items.title: Photos: Israeli attacks kill nine people, including two children, in Gaza
items.description: Israeli air attacks and gunfire kill nine Palestinians in Gaza despite ceasefire, medics say.

items.title: Ultra-Orthodox rioters briefly breach base that houses military prison, courts
items.description: Dozens of protesters walk in through gates of Beit Lid facility, where they clash with soldiers; no injuries or arrests reported The post Ultra-Orthodox rioters briefly breach base that houses military prison, courts appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: How Ukraine is turning Crimea, the Russians' Riviera, into a battlefield
items.description: The annexed Ukrainian peninsula, which Vladimir Putin sees as his crowning jewel, has descended into chaos as Kyiv ramps up attacks on the territory. Shocked tourists and residents express their distress as shortages worsen.

items.title: International court tells BBC of breakthrough in Sudan war crimes probe
items.description: The ICC has been looking into atrocities committed in Darfur over the past three years.

items.title: Trump says the U.S. will give license to Ukraine to produce Patriot defense systems
items.description: President Donald Trump said Wednesday that the U.S. will give a licence to Ukraine to manufacture Patriot air defense systems to help counter Russian missile attacks, a huge coup for Ukraine which has badly needed the technology for the war now in its fifth year. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports.

items.description: Lo ha detto il presidente Usa in un bilaterale con Volodymyr Zelensky

items.title: Sudan: ‘El Obeid must not become the next crime scene’ warn UN investigators
items.description: Atrocities committed by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) militia against Sudanese civilians in El Fasher in October – including mass killings, abductions and gang rapes – bear the markers of genocide, independent UN human rights investigators reported on Wednesday.

items.title: Trump says ceasefire with Iran is 'over' as NATO summit wraps
items.description: President Trump said he believes the current ceasefire with Iran is over following an exchange of attacks between the U.S. and Iran in the latest escalation straining the agreement to end the war.

items.title: At Least 2 Killed in Russia as Ukraine Hits Multiple Oil Refineries
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said his military struck oil refineries in the Saratov region and republics of Tatarstan and Bashkortostan.

items.title: Trump Says Deal With Iran 'Is Over' Following Renewed Strikes
items.description: The United States launched a new round of military strikes against Iran and revoked a key sanctions waiver covering Iranian oil sales after accusing Tehran of attacking commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, putting a fragile cease-fire into peril.

items.title: Russian Ballistic Missile Strike Injures 9 in Odesa Region
items.description: Russian armed forces struck the Odesa region on the evening of Tuesday, with a ballistic missile armed with a cluster warhead, damaging a production facility building and several vehicles. items.title: Ukraine: Suspect in Monaco bomb attack found dead near Kyiv
items.description: Ukrainain prosecutors say the body of the woman suspected of the bombing that targeted businessman Vadym Yermolaiev was found near Kyiv. Police said they had detained two individuals suspected of murdering her.

items.title: Did the US-Israeli war against Iran save the Islamic Republic?
items.description: Before the U.S.-Israeli war, the Iranian regime appeared to face an existential threat stemming from its violent repression of dissent in January and chronic grievances over corruption and the economy. But now the Islamic Republic is exuding bold confidence.
